brief.claim: In a study of 60 participants, those who perform worst at the start of a perceptual-learning task benefit most from training: the improvement (late-block score minus early-block score) of the lower-scoring half exceeds that of the higher-scoring half by at least 4 points, with an independent-samples t-test p < 0.05 (one-sided).

data_keys.meaning: percent correct (0 to 100) in each of 4 consecutive blocks of the task, block 0 first and block 3 last
